_status: UNRUN native snapshot diagnostic. Replace every path and lock the actual checkpoint, donor versions and snapshot time. Do not relabel the old momentum diagnostic as this experiment.
_continuation: Change kind to continuation and use DEV-locked fit_epochs (e.g. the registered 32). Branches complete_state/reset_receiving/cold_local share z,h,C; reset_receiving resets beta, cold_local resets phi and beta. Every optimizer is new. Same epochs do not imply identical measured cost.
_matched_work: For kind=matched_work supply records, policies, pair_fields, tolerance and a new output. Optional expected_pairs locks planned pair identities and retains even completely missing pairs. Flat records require each pair identity, policy, status=completed, work_unit, target_work, actual_work, value. Missing/failed/under-target/over-ceiling rows remain rejected and are never zero-filled.
